_about: Taxes and fees on a Vietnamese residential property transfer, as used by vnrealty/legal/checklist.py::transaction_costs. Rates are fractions. Every item carries its legal basis and the URLs it was checked against on the date below; secondary legal sites were used where the official gazette was not reachable, so confirm with the local tax office (Chi cục Thuế) and a notary before relying on a number. Not legal or tax advice.

registration_fee.vi: Lệ phí trước bạ nhà, đất
registration_fee.base_rule: 0.5% of the transfer price when that is above the provincial land/house price table value; otherwise of the table value (so: max(contract price, official value) when the official value is known).
registration_fee.legal_basis: Nghị định 10/2022/NĐ-CP, Điều 8 khoản 1 (amended by Nghị định 175/2025/NĐ-CP — check the consolidated text)

seller_pit.vi: Thuế thu nhập cá nhân từ chuyển nhượng bất động sản
seller_pit.base_rule: 2% of the transfer price. Since 2025 the tax authority's guidance (Công văn 5921/TCT-CS, 16/12/2024) ties the taxable price for land-use-right transfers to the land price table when the contract price is lower; vnrealty uses max(contract price, official value) when the official value is known.
seller_pit.legal_basis: Luật Thuế TNCN 109/2025/QH15, Điều 14 (in force 01/07/2026; keeps 2% for residents and non-residents; amended by Luật 09/2026/QH16 — amendment not checked); before 01/07/2026: Luật Thuế TNCN 2007 as amended

notary_fee.vi: Phí công chứng hợp đồng mua bán, chuyển nhượng nhà đất
notary_fee.payer_note: by convention; the contract can assign it to either party
notary_fee.base_rule: on the contract value (land use right plus the house on it). Each tier: fixed + rate x (value - over). Capped at 70,000,000 VND per case. Notary 'thù lao' (drafting, copies) is extra and set by each office.
notary_fee.legal_basis: Thông tư 257/2016/TT-BTC, Điều 4 khoản 2 điểm a2 (amended by Thông tư 111/2017/TT-BTC; Thông tư 64/2025/TT-BTC's temporary 50% cuts were not found to cover this fee)

developer_vat.vi: Thuế GTGT khi mua từ chủ đầu tư
developer_vat.payer: buyer (normally already inside the developer's quoted price)
developer_vat.base_rule: 10% of the sale price before VAT minus the land use fee (tiền sử dụng đất) or land rent paid to the State. Without the land-use-fee figure the VAT amount cannot be computed; it is reported as insufficient.
developer_vat.legal_basis: Luật Thuế GTGT 48/2024/QH15, Điều 7 khoản 1 điểm h; real estate is outside the temporary 2-point VAT cut

broker_fee.base_rule: a negotiated share of the price; passed in as broker_rate. Commonly quoted 1-2% in Đà Nẵng listings.
broker_fee.note: No legal rate exists; 1-2% is market lore, not a sourced number, which is why the function takes it as a parameter and has no default.

not_included: Phí thẩm định hồ sơ cấp giấy chứng nhận (set by each province's People's Council resolution)
Lệ phí cấp giấy chứng nhận (province-set, small)
Notary thù lao (drafting, copying) beyond the fee
Maintenance fund 2% for new apartments (phí bảo trì, Luật Nhà ở 2023) — payable to the developer on a new condo
